Prices for the stay of Nov 4 to 6, 2026, as listed on September 30, 2026.

18 Vail hotels, each priced on every booking site we recorded for it. Prices on this page are per night, all-in where the sites reported taxes and fees; the study's count below uses the before-tax prices of its CSV. The going rate is the price the largest number of listings that named a room or offered free cancellation agreed on (ties go to the lower price).

One snapshot on September 30, 2026 for Nov 4 to Nov 6, 2 adults, US market, USD. Prices change daily.

Which booking site listed the lowest prices for Vail hotels?

The study's count, before taxes and fees: in the September 30, 2026 snapshot, at 12 of the 18 Vail hotels with a price, the lowest-priced listing was 5% or more below the going rate. Sites with the lowest price there: Super.com at 3, Vio.com at 2, dealbase.com at 1, goseek.com at 1, Luxury Escapes at 1, Priceline at 1, Traveloka.com at 1, Traveluro at 1 and 1 other site at 1 between them. These are the Vail rows of the study's per-hotel CSV (going_rate_usd and cheapest_usd, before taxes and fees).

Taxes and fees at Vail hotels

At the 13 hotels with both an all-in and a before-tax going rate, taxes and fees, as the booking sites reported them to Google Hotels, added a median of 11% ($29 a night) to the before-tax going rate: from 10% at Gravity Haus Vail to 11% at Residence Inn by Marriott Vail. At 5 hotels no site reported a before-tax price, so their prices are listed prices that may leave out resort or property fees. Our data does not split the gap into taxes and fees.
